evidence: apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/todos-dark-1440.png ("Open Kitchen history" link on a root Todos row navigates to Kitchen's header)
apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/archive-dark-1440.aria.yml ("Open Legacy attic history" → /projects/project-legacy#history-controls)
apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/kitchen-collapsed-dark-1440.aria.yml (Undo label names the step only in the displayed project's header)
repro: 3. open /projects/project-renovation/pages/todos and look for a way to undo it
findings.expected: Users can find what they changed and reverse it from where they are.
findings.actual: History has no place of its own: Undo/Redo exist only in the header of the project that owns the change, so reversing work seen on root Todos or Archive means following a link to another project's header. There is no list of past steps anywhere in the UI.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #3 User control and freedom

findings.surface: global sidebar › Projects group
findings.inventoryRow: Global shell, desktop sidebar, phone navigation drawer, top bar
evidence: apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/busy-week-project-dark-1440.png (all roots and nested workstreams expanded)
apps/e2e/ux-output/c94f0f0e97a3004ac8e2359a116bed6bc1fdf0fc/nested-projects-project-dark-1440.aria.yml (button "Projects" toggles the group; no per-project expand control)
apps/web/src/app/core/shell/sidebar/sidebar.html (comment: no /projects route exists)
repro: 3. try to collapse one project in the sidebar, or open a list of all projects
findings.expected: A way to see all projects at a glance and to keep a growing tree manageable (§23: hierarchy "optionally" expands inline).
findings.actual: The Projects heading looks like a section label but is an all-or-nothing toggle; every root is always expanded to full depth with no per-project disclosure, and there is no projects index destination. Archived projects are only under Settings.
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #7 Flexibility and efficiency of use; Nielsen #8 Aesthetic and minimalist design
